description: This file provides a class CouponStore that manages local persistence of a Coupon object via SharedPreferences and JSON serialization.

classes.name: CouponStore
classes.description: A class providing methods to load, save, and clear a Coupon object in local storage using SharedPreferences and JSON serialization.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Retrieves the Coupon object from SharedPreferences, returning null if none exists or if deserialization fails.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and saves a Coupon object into SharedPreferences, or removes it if null.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the Coupon data from SharedPreferences.
